cause: Training/serving skew from a missing log transform. The training pipeline applied a log1p transform to f2 (training f2 == ln(1 + serving f2), confirmed to floating-point precision with max error ~6e-7 over all 200 joined entities), while the online serving path served the raw, untransformed value (serving f2 == exp(training f2) - 1). f1, f3, f4, f5 match exactly (mean absolute difference 0.0). Fix: apply the same log1p transformation to f2 in the serving/inference path (or register it as a Hopsworks transformation function on the feature view so it is applied consistently at both training and serving time).
